MDP enhances the phagocytotic activity of microglial cells and this effect is further increased by pre-stimulation of the cells with agonists of TLR1/3/4.
MDP enhances phagocytic capacity of microglia, and that this effect is strengthened when microglia are co-stimulated with a TLR ligand.

the modulation of microglial phagocytic function by Nod2 and its synergistic effect in combination with TLR1/4.
the role of the Nod2 receptor in the phagocytotic capacity of microglia.
the activation of Nod2 in microglia.

the Nod2 receptor is a potent enhancer of the phagocytotic and bactericidal activity of microglial cells.
the Nod2/TLR4 axis is a promising candidate for the development of novel therapeutic approaches in the treatment of bacterial infections of the CNS.

the Nod2-TLR4 pathway is the main player in enhancing phagocytotic capacity of microglia.
